title: gRPC connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One gRPC instance's settings, read by the native protocols family (`loams_connector_protocols::grpc`, CN2 Task 21): a dynamic client over gRPC's HTTP/2 protocol (R21.2) with messages built from `descriptor_set` or the server's reflection service. `jwt` and `tls.*` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`. A sink's answers are reply events on `reply_topic` (R-CN2-3).

descriptor_set.description: A `FileDescriptorSet`, base64 (`protoc --include_imports --descriptor_set_out=…`); without it set `reflection: true`.

reflection.description: Ask the server's `grpc.reflection.v1` service (falling back to `v1alpha`) for the services and their imports.

client_cert.description: The client certificate chain (mTLS); goes with `client_key`. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

client_key.description: The client private key (mTLS). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

ca.description: A CA bundle replacing the web PKI roots. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

jwt.description: A bearer JWT (`Authorization: Bearer`). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

source.description: A server-streaming call: one split per method, each streamed message one `message` event.

request.description: The request message, as proto3 JSON.

cursor.description: Makes the source resumable: a restart re-opens the call with `request_field` set to the last message's value at `response_pointer`.

request_field.description: The request field set to the cursor (a field name or a pointer).

response_pointer.description: Where the cursor is in each message's proto3 JSON (a JSON pointer).

reconnect_ms.description: Re-open the call this long after the server ended it; without it the source finishes.

linger_ms.description: How long a read waits for more messages once it has one.

sink.description: Unary calls, one per event; the answer is the reply.

request_pointer.description: Where the request is in the event's data (a JSON pointer); the whole data when omitted.

reply_topic.description: Where replies go: one reply event per input, `io.loams.dev.flow.grpc.reply.v1` with id `<input id>/reply`, keeping the input's subject and carrying `loamsinreplyto`/`loamsinreplytosource` (OR-19, R21.6). Without it no replies are sent.
